hints.text: This clue's indicators are 'Out-of-control' and 'leads to'. One of these is an anagram indicator, flagging that some neighbouring letters will need to be mixed up. The other is a selection indicator telling us which letters from some nearby fodder we should pay attention to.
This clue's fodder is 'car' and 'something horrible'. We'll use these letters (or some of them) to construct our answer, as guided by the clue's indicator(s).

This clue is an &lit, meaning that the whole clue is both the wordplay and the definition. So, our answer will be something horrible that is led to by an out-of-control car. Heads up: while we have previously denoted &lits with the !? punctuation on the end, we will soon be using subtler forms of signifying this, like a single exclamation point: !
